title: Rabbi Chaggai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites the Zohar, Lekh Lekha 89 and Pinchas 98a, for mentions of him with Rabbi Chiyya and Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon.

notes.text: The two Zohar locators are retained as supplied. No matching named passage is available in the returned evidence to verify these occurrences and the accompanying names; the source question remains open.

The same encounter appears in two places. In Zohar I 89a–90a, in Lekh Lekha, Rabbi Chiyya meets Rabbi Chaggai on his way to see Rabbi Elazar. The Sulzbach edition (1684) prints this account as an addendum under Pinchas on folio 98a.
